text:
maria: Heads-up — need to reschedule next release train slot (week of Dec 22). UK office has a public holiday and several engineers are OOO. Can we shift the whole train one week earlier or compress the cutoff? :thinking:
ben: Earlier seems safer than compressing. Do we have capacity to land PRs a week sooner?
oliver: Quick check — whats the changelog cutoff today? I thought it was Thu at 11:59am PT.
maria: Cutoff is Thu 11:59am PT (standard). If we move earlier we'd need to nudge feature owners. I can send a reminder but we need a decision on the window.
sarah: If we move the slot up one week, can we keep the canary window same length? We should avoid shortening verification.
ben: Proposal: keep canary 48h, move train to Dec 15 slot, patch window stays same. That gives teams an extra week after holiday.
oliver: If we do Dec 15, changelog cutoff becomes Dec 11 11:59am PT. I'll ping infra and QA owners now.
maria: @ben @sarah ok to make that move? If yes I'll update the calendar and post in #general.
devops-bot: [calendar] Scheduled change pending confirmation: move release-train from 2026-12-22 -> 2026-12-15; new cutoff 2026-12-11 19:59 UTC. Run /release-calendar confirm 1834567890 to finalize.
tim: Quick ops question — do we need to update branch protection windows? We currently block force-push from cutoff->ship.
sarah: Yes, we should shift branch-freeze rules to match new cutoff. @tim can you help update the rule in repo settings?
tim: Yup. I'll update the policy tonight:```
branch-freeze: true
freeze_start: 2026-12-11T12:00:00-08:00
freeze_end: 2026-12-16T23:59:00-08:00
```
maria: Thanks. I'll draft a short changelog-nudge post for leads: "Heads up: cutoff moved to Dec 11 to accommodate UK holiday — please land or defer PRs accordingly."
ben: +1. Also can we run a quick auto-eval on the canary model bump? I don't want an unexpected perf regression during the verification window.
oliver: I'll queue the eval against canary on staging and share results in this thread.
maria: Great — unless anyone objects I'll confirm the calendar change at EOD and follow up with announce + checklist. :thumbsup:
